gloss: one by one; one at a time

definitions.gloss: one by one; one at a time; one each
definitions.explanation: Indicates doing or distributing something one unit at a time. The counter 個 is used for small, discrete objects.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一個|いっこ}ずつ⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: To hand out sweets one each.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一個|いっこ}ずつ⟦{割|わ}って→割る：02334_waru⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please crack and add the eggs one at a time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一個|いっこ}ずつ⟦{片付|かたづ}けて→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧いけば、いつか⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧{終|お}わる。
examples.english: If you tackle the problems one by one, you'll eventually finish them all.

notes:
{一個|いっこ}ずつ means 'one at a time' or 'one each,' using the versatile counter ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ for small, discrete objects.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Part of the ～⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧ pattern, which attaches to a quantity to mean 'each' or 'at a time.' The same structure works with other counters:
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧ (one person at a time)
- ⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧ (one sheet at a time)
- ⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧ (one [long object] at a time)
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧ (little by little)

USAGE:
- Very common in everyday speech because ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ is a general-purpose counter for small objects
- Often used for distributing items: ⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一個|いっこ}ずつ⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧ (hand out sweets one each)
- Also used for doing things methodically: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一個|いっこ}ずつ⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧ (solve problems one at a time)
